construction.base_displacement: object world XY minus robot root world XY
construction.full_task_reset: direct env.reset_idx snapshot after its own physics tick; no extra placement, ground alignment, gripper opening, velocity clearing or motion-heading filter
construction.gripper_opening: 0=closed upper joint limit, 1=open lower joint limit
construction.heading_offset: unsigned angle between robot forward and initial signed local departure direction, degrees
construction.heading_sampling: motion yaw +/- sampled angle; choose the side nearer the bearing to object
construction.motion_heading_constraint: robot forward XY dot initial signed local departure direction > 0; table starts at rest, so direction comes from the saved driver intention
construction.motion_state: full_task: untouched ordinary uninitialized driver; curriculum: sampled driver intention; all filter states saved; future random corrections remain stochastic
construction.object_yaw: full_task uses ordinary reset; curriculum uses configured offline world-z offsets
construction.pregrasp_orientation: candidate quaternion * local roll-pitch-yaw delta quaternion
construction.pregrasp_position: candidate local [-sqrt(d*d-y*y-z*z), y, z]; d is Euclidean distance
construction.sampling: ordinary full-task resets; curriculum geometry targets followed by IK and physics checks

collision_check.method: full_task: actual ordinary-reset table/chassis check; curriculum: every-frame joint limits/contact forces, displacement and support

physical_validation.near_goal_contact_check: both finger net contact forces, object between finger surfaces, collision mesh above table
physical_validation.table_control: nominal support pose held during placement/grasp construction; Level03 rest-start motion restored for near-goal cold replay and training reset

validation_by_family.at_grasp: candidate position/orientation reached, partially open gripper, pregrasp base ranges and short geometric physics window
validation_by_family.full_task: finite actual ordinary-reset state and table/chassis clearance; ordinary startup transients retained, no additional physics window
validation_by_family.near_goal: physical close/lift/hold and cold-reset grip verification

notes.coverage: Distributions of actual stored states, not the configured target ranges.
notes.first_rejection_counts: Mutually exclusive first failed check in check_order; totals equal invalid.
notes.histograms: Ten bins across observed values; constant values use a small display interval.
notes.rejection_counts: Independent failed checks; one proposal may be counted more than once.
notes.stored: A valid proposal actually selected for the saved bank.
notes.valid: A proposal passing all checks before the family quota is applied.
